CheatEntry.AssemblerScript: [ENABLE] {$lua} if syntaxcheck then return end local busy = getAddressSafe('pmwLLBusy') local request = getAddressSafe('pmwLLRequest') local result = getAddressSafe('pmwLLResult') if not busy or not request or not result then error('Enable Load Level first.') end local gameAddress = getAddressSafe('"PMA_W32_M.exe"+3CDF50') local game = gameAddress and readInteger(gameAddress) if not game or game == 0 or readInteger(game + 0x18E4) ~= 18 or not readInteger(game + 0x19E4) or readInteger(game + 0x19E4) == 0 then error('Wait until normal gameplay has resumed before loading a level.') end if readInteger(busy) ~= 0 or readInteger(request) ~= 0 then error('A level load is already in progress.') end local record = memrec local timer = createTimer(nil, false) timer.Interval = 100 timer.OnTimer = function(t) local ok, active = pcall(function() return record.Active and record.Parent.Active end) if not ok or not active then t.destroy() pcall(function() record.Active = false end) return end if readInteger(request) ~= 0 then return end local value = readInteger(result) t.destroy() pcall(function() record.Active = false end) if value and value > 1 then local messages = { [2]='Unsupported level or command.', [3]='Wait for normal gameplay.', [4]='Game mode unavailable.', [5]='No active world.', [6]='A level load is already in progress.', [7]='Level table mismatch.' } showMessage('Level load rejected: '..(messages[value] or tostring(value))) end end if not writeInteger(result, 0) or not writeInteger(request, 1) then timer.destroy() error('Could not submit the level load request.') end timer.Enabled = true {$asm} [DISABLE]
